Digital copy http://digital.slub-dresden.de/id1696251605; catalogue Kalliope DE-611-HS-3576380.
seen.extent: 198 pages plus 7 leaves; about 44 images examined: the front legend and the 'Zeit-Arbeit' (labour time) tables.
seen.cipher: Image 4 is a legend: 'P' with dots above and below followed by plain German: 'bedeutet ein Meister', 'einen Gesellen', 'ein Meister und Gesellen', '2 Gesellen', '1 Meister und 2 Gesellen' (reading uncertain at that size). The tables on Seiten 57-88 are in ordinary German script with ruled columns and the same P-with-dots marks in a margin column. Kalliope: 'z.T. in Geheimschrift geschrieben'. I saw no running cipher text; the other pages (Seiten 89-198) were not viewed.
